description.mn: Afnan Supremacy In Oud: Unisex өвслөг үнэр (Extrait). Эхний ноот: гүргэм, задийн самар, лаванда; зүрхний ноот: агар мод, чихэрлэг ноот; суурь ноот: пачули, заар.
description.en: Supremacy in Oud by Afnan Perfumes is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Supremacy in Oud was launched in 2021. Top notes are Saffron, Nutmeg and Lavender; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Sweet Notes; base notes are Patchouli and Musk.
